notes: Anubis permit office. Three rows of four steel desks (z 4.0, 6.6, 9.2), clerks facing the camera-side wall. The narrator's desk is desk_a2 (x -1.2); his coworker sits five feet away at desk_a3 (x 0.3). A long service counter runs across the front at z 1.2 with the public side toward z 0. Filing cabinets line the left wall, frosted windows the right wall, a wall clock and notice board on the far wall. Named marks for the seats are in clay_film marks/permit-office.json.
look: Colour photograph, the clerical floor of a municipal permit office in the middle of a weekday. Painted cinderblock walls in pale institutional green, speckled grey vinyl tile floor worn along the aisles, powder-coated grey steel, black vinyl, beige enamel, cork, manila card, rubber and ink. Light from banks of overhead fluorescent tubes, flat and slightly green, with a cooler grey daylight through frosted glass on the right; soft even shadows under every surface, a faint sheen on the tile. Muted palette of institutional green, beige and grey, the only strong colours the red and green of ink. Available-light photograph on 35mm, natural contrast, fine surface detail, sharp focus on the subject.
_look_note: Materials, light and film character only. Furniture nouns (desk, chair, cabinet, counter, clock, window, door, board, folder) are absent so nothing is asserted into a frame that cannot see it.
